company_name: Zhangjiagang Deyizhou Precision Filter Material Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company produces filtration products that are used in semiconductor manufacturing processes, but it does not directly supply semiconductor materials or equipment.
summary: Zhangjiagang Deyizhou Precision Filter Material Co., Ltd specializes in the production of microporous filtration products, including filter cartridges and housings, which are essential for maintaining clean environments in semiconductor manufacturing. With over 20 years of experience, the company operates advanced production lines and cleanroom facilities to ensure high-quality filtration solutions.
capabilities: Complete filter cartridge assembly in cleanroom
